name: African Church of the Holy Spirit

citations.locator: African Church of the Holy Spirit, member profile
citations.excerpt: The African Church of the Holy Spirit came into being in 1927, as the result of a split in the Friends African Mission.
They were expelled from the mission and the ACHS was officially established as an independent church in 1933.
as the result of a split in the Friends African Mission.

facts.value: Trinitarian, accepting the Apostles' and Nicene Creeds. Baptism in the Holy Spirit of adults. No celebration of Holy Communion.

citations.excerpt: The church accepts the scriptures as the supreme rule of faith and life and the Apostles' and Nicene Creeds as containing the substance of faith of the church.
Holy communion is not celebrated because the presence of the Holy Spirit in the believer takes the place of the eucharist
